extra.message: User input from the 'username' query parameter is directly concatenated into a Jinja2 template string on line 14: Jinja2.from_string("Welcome " + username + "!").render(). This allows Server-Side Template Injection (SSTI) which can lead to Remote Code Execution. An attacker can inject Jinja2 expressions like {{ 7*7 }} or use introspection to access Python's __class__.__mro__ and __subclasses__ to execute arbitrary code, read files, or take control of the server. The safe implementation using template variables is commented out on line 17.

cwe: CWE-94: Improper Control of Generation of Code ('Code Injection')
CWE-95: Improper Neutralization of Directives in Dynamically Evaluated Code ('Eval Injection')
